statements.text: So, we're going into an era of disinformation. Political rhetoric is going to be weaponized. People are going to be misquoted, lied about. There are going to be all sort[s] of programs that can act like they're synthesizing and recreating our messages and words. This is something we should have a conversation about.
statements.venue: CNN This Morning interview (reported by Breitbart/Mixed Times)
